_________________________________________________________________
                                          Data Export Details
We provide patient data in standardized formats for electronic health information export 170.315 (b)(10). Here
are the detailed formats.

1. Demographics and Insurance:

    The data will be exported in excel format. This file contains comprehensive patient demographics and
    insurance details.

2. Medications and Allergies:

    The data will be exported in excel format. This file contains patient medications and allergies details.

3. Problems:

    The data will be exported in excel format. This file contains the active patient diagnosis.

4. Lab Results:

    The data will be exported in excel format. This file contains structured patient lab results.

5. Visit Summaries:

    The visit summary contains all the details of each encounter.

    The data will be exported in PDF format and CDA format (as per HL7 CDA standards). A reference link
    document is provided in excel format.

6. Documents:

    This includes all the scanned or imported documents in the patient chart. A reference file is provided with the
    document index, file information, folder names and patient details.

It is crucial to protect patient data privacy and security. Every export is carried out securely by using reliable
encryption standards and safe transmission techniques. In accordance with any applicable laws pertaining to
the protection of health data, we counsel our clients to handle the exported data carefully. We are committed
to staying updated with industry standards and practices. For any updates on any changes to our export
procedures, kindly check this link on our website on a regular basis.
